catalogue_requests.reason: No catalogue class fits a single rosbridge publication of a TwistStamped velocity setpoint: cap.motion.mobile_base.v1 requires a bounded duration plus distance and heading output, while the upstream callback consumes only twist.linear.x and twist.angular.z and publishes no motion acknowledgement. A rosbridge publish receipt is transmission evidence only.

No catalogue class fits the upstream std_srvs/SetBool motor-torque service. cap.motion.stop.v1 requires a stopped-state report that the motor_torque_enable register write does not provide; claiming stopped=true would be invented.
The fixed, input-free torque-disable safe-state action has no catalogue class. cap.motion.stop.v1 would require inventing a stopped-state measurement from a torque-enable register acknowledgement.
